title: BREACH — Blacksite
description: Modern Three.js horde-survival FPS with three detailed weapons, spring-based weapon inertia, distinct recoil, animated soldiers and directional hit reactions. MK18 uses a 2.4× picture-in-picture red-dot optic with an unzoomed peripheral view; shotgun and marksman rifle use iron sights. Includes sprint, slide, jump, reload and inspection animations, SSAO, bloom and procedural audio.
